title: LaborWise
recruiterSummary: A Philippine employment-rights service running on Azure, with a web API and scheduled legal-source updates.
story: The useful story is not private source code. It is the sanitized architecture, operational choices, and lessons that can be shared safely.
What stayed with me: responsible documentation can make private work understandable without making it exposed.
